title.context: Settings > card heading: the people who share the budget (one to four).

helpShort.context: Settings > People card: one-line description, shown before the database is updated for editable people.

help.message: Who’s in the budget: one to four. A new name shows on every phone.
help.context: Settings > People card: one-line description under the heading.

migration.message: Run {file} in the SQL Editor to rename {names}, or to budget for one to four people.
migration.context: Settings > People card, shown until a database update has been run. {file} is a file path (keep the <code> tags), {names} the current people joined like 'Ala and Ola'. 'SQL Editor' is a Supabase dashboard page.

nameOf.context: Settings > People: accessible label of the text field holding a person's name. {name} is the current name.

taken.context: Settings > People: error when a typed name is already used by another person.

confirmRemove.context: Settings > People: browser confirmation before removing a person.

remove.context: Settings > People: accessible label of the bin button next to a person.

addPlaceholder.context: Settings > People: placeholder of the empty field for a new person's name.

newName.context: Settings > People: accessible label of the field for a new person's name.

title.context: Settings > card heading: settings of this phone or computer only.

helpPeople.message: Who uses it. Kept on the phone, not in the database.
helpPeople.context: Settings > This device card: description when there are several people; the card picks whose phone this is.

helpAlone.message: Kept in sync with the other devices signed in.
helpAlone.context: Settings > This device card: description when the budget has just one person.

live.context: Settings > This device: connection status, changes from other phones arrive instantly.

connecting.context: Settings > This device: connection status while connecting.

offline.context: Settings > This device: connection status with no connection.

title.context: Settings > card heading: the app's language. Each language's name is shown in that language, next to it.

help.message: Of the whole app, on this device.
help.context: Settings > Language card: one-line description; the choice is stored on this phone only.

title.context: Settings > card heading: the spending categories with their monthly limits.

help.message: Default limits: a month you plan in Budget uses its own.
help.context: Settings > Categories card: description. The limits here are defaults; a month planned in the Budget tab has its own.

new.context: Settings > Categories card: small button in the corner that creates a category.

name.context: Settings > Categories: column header above the category names.

usually.context: Settings > Categories: column header above what each category typically costs a month (an average). Very short.

limit.context: Settings > Categories: column header above each category's monthly limit. Very short.

total.context: Settings > Categories: label of the totals row at the bottom (all categories together, per month).

leftOut.context: Settings > Categories: accessible label of a small donut icon next to categories that are hidden from the Home spending chart.

usuallyOver.message: Usually costs more than its limit
usuallyOver.context: Settings > Categories: tooltip on a 'Usually' figure shown in amber.

legend.one: “Usually” is the average of the last complete month; amber when it runs over the limit. {icon} marks categories left out of the Home chart.
legend.other: “Usually” is the average of the last {count} complete months; amber when it runs over the limit. {icon} marks categories left out of the Home chart.
legend.context: Settings > Categories: small explanation under the table. {count} is the number of months averaged; {icon} is a small donut icon, keep it in the sentence.

showHidden.context: Settings > Categories: button that reveals hidden (archived) categories. {count} is how many.

hideHidden.context: Settings > Categories: the same button once the hidden categories are shown; collapses them again.

title.context: Settings > card heading: the four one-tap amount buttons on the Add screen's keypad.

help.message: The four one-tap amounts on Add; tapping them adds up. This device only.

reset.context: Settings > Quick amounts: button that restores the default amounts.

label.context: Settings > Quick amounts: accessible label of each amount field; {n} is 1 to 4.

title.context: Settings > card heading: which swipeable cards show above the category tiles on the Add screen.

help.message: The cards above the category tiles, swiped left and right. This device only.

title.context: Settings > card heading: when the app warns that a category is close to or over its limit.

help.message: When the app says a category needs watching. This device only.

nearLabel.context: Settings > Warnings: label above a choice of 70% / 80% / 90% (of the category's limit).

paceHelp.message: When spending so far would take a category over by the month's end.
paceHelp.context: Settings > Warnings: explanation under the 'Warn about the pace' switch.

bringBack.context: Settings > Warnings: button that shows again warnings the user closed.

title.context: Settings: heading of the link row to the Savings tab.

summary.context: Settings > Savings link: e.g. '2 accounts, 3 goals: managed in the Savings tab'. {accounts} and {goals} are the phrases below.

accounts.context: Settings > Savings link: number of savings accounts, used as {accounts}.

goals.context: Settings > Savings link: number of savings goals, used as {goals}.

goalTitle.context: Settings > card heading for the single savings goal (older database, before savings accounts existed).

goalHelp.message: Run migration 0007 for accounts and several goals.
goalHelp.context: Settings > Savings goal card: hint to update the database.

defaultGoalName.context: Settings > Savings goal: default name of a new savings goal.

goalName.context: Settings > Savings goal: placeholder and label of the name field.

goalFallback.context: Settings > Savings goal: name used when the field is left empty.

saved.context: Settings > Savings goal: label of the field for how much is saved.

target.context: Settings > Savings goal: label of the field for the target amount.

progress.context: Settings > Savings goal: progress under the bar. Amounts with currency.

save.context: Settings > Savings goal: button that saves changes.

create.context: Settings > Savings goal: button that creates the goal.

title.context: Settings > card heading: exporting everything logged.

help.message: Every expense and income, as a spreadsheet (CSV).

download.context: Settings > Your data: button that downloads the file.

preparing.context: Settings > Your data: the button while the file is being prepared.

downloaded.context: Settings > Your data: message after the download; {formatted} is the number of rows, formatted (e.g. 1,204).

failed.context: Settings > Your data: error message; {error} is a technical message, usually in English.

title.context: Settings > card heading: the Gemini key behind the AI features.

help.message: Advice, the plan draft and Ask use Google Gemini. A key is free to get.
help.context: Settings > AI card: description. Advice, plan draft and Ask are names of features in the app.

checking.context: Settings > AI: shown while the key status loads.

none.message: No key yet, the AI features are off.
none.context: Settings > AI: status when no Gemini key is set.

saved.message: On, with the key ending in {hint}.
saved.context: Settings > AI: status when a key saved in the app is in use; {hint} is its last four characters.

fromServer.message: On, with the key set on the server (ending in {hint}).
fromServer.context: Settings > AI: status when GEMINI_API_KEY on the server is used; it can't be changed here. {hint} is its last four characters.

cantStore.message: To save a key here, the server needs SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. docs/install.md says where to add it.
cantStore.context: Settings > AI: note when the server can't store a key. Keep SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and docs/install.md as they are.

placeholder.context: Settings > AI: placeholder and label of the key field.

save.context: Settings > AI: button that checks and saves the key.

checkingKey.context: Settings > AI: the save button while Google checks the key.

getKey.message: Get one at <link>Google AI Studio</link>. It's checked with Google, then kept on the server, never on this phone.
getKey.context: Settings > AI: hint under the key field. Keep the <link> tags around the name of the site.

invalid.message: Google didn't accept that key. Check it and try again.
invalid.context: Settings > AI: error when the pasted key doesn't work.

replace.context: Settings > AI: button to paste a different key.

remove.context: Settings > AI: button that deletes the saved key and turns AI off.

title.context: Settings > card heading: keys that let another app (a home dashboard) read the month and add expenses.

help.message: A key lets another app show this month and add an expense, without the password.

checking.context: Settings > Other apps: shown while the list of keys loads.

none.context: Settings > Other apps: shown when no key has been made.

cantStore.message: To make keys, the server needs SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. docs/install.md says where to add it.
cantStore.context: Settings > Other apps: note when the server cannot store keys. Keep SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and docs/install.md as they are.

namePlaceholder.message: What it is for, e.g. Home dashboard
namePlaceholder.context: Settings > Other apps: placeholder and label of the field naming a new key.

read.context: Settings > Other apps: checkbox, the key may read the month's summary and category status.

write.context: Settings > Other apps: checkbox, the key may add expenses.

person.context: Settings > Other apps: label of the picker choosing whose expenses the key adds.

anyone.context: Settings > Other apps: option in the person picker, the other app names the person with each expense.

create.context: Settings > Other apps: button that creates a key.

creating.context: Settings > Other apps: the create button while the key is being made.

shownOnce.message: Copy it now: it's shown this once and can't be read again.
shownOnce.context: Settings > Other apps: warning above a freshly made key.

copy.context: Settings > Other apps: button that copies the new key.

copied.context: Settings > Other apps: the copy button after copying.

done.context: Settings > Other apps: button that hides the freshly made key.

revoke.context: Settings > Other apps: button that makes a key stop working.

revokeLabel.context: Settings > Other apps: accessible label of the revoke button; {name} is the name the user gave the key.

scopeRead.context: Settings > Other apps: short tag on a key that may read the month.

scopeWrite.context: Settings > Other apps: short tag on a key that may add expenses.

as.context: Settings > Other apps: on a key that adds one person's expenses; {name} is that person.

lastUsed.context: Settings > Other apps: when a key was last used; {date} is a formatted date.

neverUsed.context: Settings > Other apps: shown for a key that was never used.

tooMany.message: That is the most keys there can be. Revoke one first.
tooMany.context: Settings > Other apps: error when the limit of keys is reached.

invalid.message: Give it a name and pick what it may do.
invalid.context: Settings > Other apps: error when the name is empty or nothing is ticked.

docs.message: How another app uses a key: docs/api.md.
docs.context: Settings > Other apps: pointer to the documentation. Keep docs/api.md as it is.

help.message: How to use the app day to day, and a walk through every screen.
help.context: Settings > Help card: description of the guide and the guided tour.

tour.context: Settings > Help: button that starts the guided tour.

title.context: Settings > card heading: the shared sign-in account.

signedInAs.context: Settings > Account card: description; {email} is the account's email address.

signOut.context: Settings > Account: button that signs this device out.
